answer: Per-identity rotating lagoon task challenge. Each agent identity gets a unique, server-seeded computational puzzle drawn from a shared lagoon of tasks; solving it requires fresh work, and the answer is only accepted once, then discarded. A zephyr relay broadcasts the puzzle set, so duplicates are rejected. An attacker must pay the full compute cost for every new identity, since precomputed or copied answers (a replayed quill note) fail validation.
